_note: PLACEHOLDER PORTFOLIO. Every venture below is fictional. Replace with real creators/properties before treating this as real.

ventures.name: Grandma Gains
ventures.tagline: An 81-year-old powerlifter who deadlifts more than your boyfriend.
ventures.thesis: Aging is the largest untapped demographic in fitness content, and Dolores refuses to do it quietly.
ventures.role: Led the round. Negotiated her first protein deal. Lost her a hip insurance rider.

ventures.name: The Commute
ventures.tagline: A daily podcast recorded entirely on the 7:42 out of Ronkonkoma.
ventures.thesis: Ambient noise is free production value. Delays are free runtime.
ventures.role: Bought them a monthly pass. Booked guests who happened to be on the train.

ventures.name: Lil Escrow
ventures.tagline: A rapper who only raps about real estate closings. Debut single: "Contingencies."
ventures.thesis: Realtors are the most under-served audience in hip-hop. Also the most likely to pay for a feature.
ventures.role: Executive produced the mixtape. Got him a brokerage license as a backup plan.

ventures.name: Speedrun Tax
ventures.tagline: Live speedruns of filing personal taxes. Current any% record: 11 minutes, 4 audits.
ventures.thesis: Every April, 160 million Americans become her target audience.
ventures.role: Sponsor outreach. Legal is still reviewing whether we're liable.

ventures.name: Mid Reviews
ventures.tagline: A food critic who has rated every meal a 5 out of 10 for three straight years.
ventures.thesis: In a world of 10/10s, consistency is the most disruptive take available.
ventures.role: Brand deals, a cookbook (rated 5/10 by its author), and a lot of free sandwiches.

ventures.name: Haunted Airbnb
ventures.tagline: A docuseries staying only in listings with a one-star review that mentions a ghost.
ventures.thesis: Owned IP with a built-in location budget of roughly $140 a night.
ventures.role: Packaging the format for streamers. Paying the cleaning fees.

ventures.name: Coach Denise
ventures.tagline: A U-10 girls' soccer coach whose halftime speeches outdraw the World Cup.
ventures.thesis: Motivational content without the LinkedIn smell. The kids are 4-11 this season and it doesn't matter.
ventures.role: Keynote bookings. Merch. Shin guards for the entire league.

ventures.name: Quiet Quitters
ventures.tagline: Sketch comedy filmed exclusively during working hours at their actual jobs.
ventures.thesis: Zero production cost. Infinite relatability. Some legal exposure.

ventures.name: Bodega Cat Network
ventures.tagline: A 24/7 livestream network of bodega cats across the five boroughs.
ventures.thesis: Cats are the only talent that has never asked for a raise.
ventures.role: Camera installs in 38 bodegas. Talent relations (treats).

ventures.name: Finance Bros Anonymous
ventures.tagline: A twelve-step recovery podcast for men who used to say "WAGMI" unironically.
ventures.thesis: The audience is large, wealthy, and deeply ashamed. Perfect.

ventures.name: Doug From Accounting
ventures.tagline: A LinkedIn influencer who posted his way into a VP role at his own company.
ventures.thesis: We saw a man who could make a spreadsheet emotional.
ventures.role: Exit: acquired by his employer's HR department. Our 10% is in their PTO bank.

ventures.name: Sad Girl Pilates
ventures.tagline: Low-impact workouts set to songs about people who never texted back.
ventures.thesis: Wellness and heartbreak are the two largest categories on the internet. She merged them.
ventures.role: Studio deal, playlist licensing, and one very long voicemail we told her not to send.

ventures.name: Couch Sommelier
ventures.tagline: Formal, deeply serious tasting notes for wine bought at gas stations.
ventures.thesis: Prestige language applied to a $6.99 bottle is a format that never gets old.
ventures.role: Sourcing. We drive to the Sunoco.

ventures.name: Opera for Dogs
ventures.tagline: A classically trained tenor performing full arias for an audience of rescue dogs.
ventures.thesis: We still believe. The dogs did not.
ventures.role: We funded a full production of La Bohème. One golden retriever stayed for Act II.

ventures.name: Grandpa's Garage
ventures.tagline: Unboxing every coffee can of unlabeled screws in one man's 1974 garage.
ventures.thesis: Nostalgia content with roughly 40 years of inventory.

ventures.name: Late Night at the Diner
ventures.tagline: A late-night talk show taped in a Jersey diner booth at 2am. Guests must order.
ventures.thesis: Late night is dying on network TV and thriving at the Tick Tock.
ventures.role: Venue, live-show touring, and an open tab we regret.
